note: Screens that hand-write a table or a text field instead of using the kit in src/ui/components/screens/, or that assemble a table from the kit's loose parts instead of taking DataTable whole. Each list may shrink, never grow — move the screen onto the kit instead of adding to it. The `tables` and `inputs` lists are finished: every entry left in them is a settled decision rather than unfinished work, each carrying its reason as a comment in the file itself and written up in docs/plans/active/shared-screen-kit-plan.md — the opportunity report stays hand-written (Anthony, 2026-08-17); WidgetPreviewPanel draws a mock-up of the customer's own chat widget rather than a form; MoneyViewScreen's two boxes sit inside a sentence, already labelled by the words around them; SettingBlock's opacity box is the same shape; and app/tasks is a grouped list with its own due-date row. The `assembled` list is the live one: 61 screens frozen on 2026-08-17, worked down as each moves onto DataTable. From 2026-08-18 the remaining work is admin-only (Anthony: "it's an admin only plan"), so the six entries under app/ and demos/ are not a queue — they stay frozen until somebody works on that screen for its own reasons. The rule is unchanged for them: the list may shrink, never grow. The `buttons` map, added 2026-08-19, freezes how many raw <button>s each file may draw — counts, not names, because a file with eleven cannot be asked to reach zero in one sitting. 408 buttons across 149 files were frozen the day Button (src/ui/components/screens/Button.tsx) shipped, after the first shrink took the runs screens, ConfigDrawer and KnowledgeManager down by ten. This rule reads all of src/app and src/ui except the movement demos, which are frozen whole by owner decision. Each count may fall, never rise — when a file loses its last raw button the check asks for its entry to be removed. The `checkboxes` list, added 2026-08-22, freezes the screens that draw a tick box by hand. This rule was deliberately absent until now: the kit had no tick box, so flagging one would have been a build failure with no correct fix. CheckboxOption and Checkbox (src/ui/components/screens/Checkbox.tsx) are that missing fix, lifted from the workspace Features screen after Anthony found it looked like a style of its own. Features moved onto the kit rather than joining this list; the 18 entries here are frozen where they stood, and as everywhere the list may shrink, never grow. The `anatomy` list, added 2026-08-22, freezes tables that sit on a page with no header above them. It is the first rule here about how a screen is assembled rather than which parts it uses — the Features screen took DataTable whole, drew nothing by hand, passed every other rule, and still put its title inside the table instead of above the search box. 46 of the 55 screens rendering DataTable already had the header above it; the 9 frozen here are sub-tables whose header lives in the parent page. As everywhere, the list may shrink, never grow. The `switches` list, added 2026-08-23, freezes the screens that draw an on/off switch out of ToggleLeft/ToggleRight glyphs. It is the tick box rule one day older, found where that rule did not reach: three system settings screens each drew a list of switches as bordered cards, wrote no table, no input and no tick box, and had their raw buttons already frozen, so nothing caught them. Anthony found them by looking: "there are new tables in the system settings that look hand drawn and need to be standardised." All three moved onto DataTable with Checkbox in the last column rather than joining this list. The 4 entries here are the retention modal's status switch, which is one control in a dialog rather than a list, and the three schedule screens. As everywhere, the list may shrink, never grow. The `shadows` list, added 2026-08-23, freezes screens that declare a component under a name src/ui/components/screens already exports. It is the first rule here about two screens copying each other rather than either copying the kit, which is exactly why nothing caught it: a private SettingSwitch redraws no shared part, it redraws what the screen next door redrew. API Keys and the connector detail screen each held one, identical to the kit's except for a row height; the agent observability screen declared a StatusPill that was not a copy but something different wearing a familiar name. The kit's names are read from the kit at check time, so adding a component protects its name the same day. This list starts EMPTY — all three were fixed the day the rule was written, so any entry added later is a deliberate act rather than inherited debt. The `dividers` list, added the same day, freezes screens that draw their own run of divided rows. `last:border-0` on a mapped row is not a style choice: "except the last one" is only something you say about a repetition, so the class is a screen announcing that it is drawing its own list. CompactList and DataTable both own their dividers, so a screen on the kit never writes it. Twelve files carried it when the sweep began — three were the leaderboard rows that became one shared part, three were panel lists (a script's run history, an audit entry's changes, a wiki page's backlinks) that moved onto CompactList, and the six here are frozen. As everywhere, the list may shrink, never grow. The `pills` map and `pillNames` list, added 2026-09-29, came the day every pill went: Anthony, looking at two on a search's page in Sites, said "I really don't like lozenges … it's a give away it's AI designed" and chose a small line icon in the status's colour followed by plain words. A status is now a StatusLabel and a kind a TagLabel (src/ui/components/screens/). What still matched the pill recipe that day is not a label at all and is frozen per file by count: code and ID snippets (HakkenMarkdown, WikiProse, the audit screens), numbered step circles (the rule, tool and invite editors), removable phrase chips (the eval editors), the workflow canvas's field names, a schema builder's type select, and the side menu's amber count. Two component names are frozen because neither draws a pill: AssistantStagePill, the assistant's turning "Thinking…" line, and PhotoActionChip, the photo action card. As everywhere, each may shrink, never grow. The `recipes` list, added 2026-10-03 with Figure, ChartCard, Notice, Meter and Change, freezes what still matched a part's own classes, or typed a ▲ or ▼, the day the parts were made and Sites, Search Console and the websites admin moved onto them (Anthony: "we need to keep a ui standard app wide"). None is a hand-drawn part: the page-one bar on Bands is two shares in one track, which Meter does not draw; New and lost's arrows are a key to four series, not a move; the Sites menu's count, `movement()` and the Sites list's download write the arrows into text, not into a cell. Each says so where it is. As everywhere, the list may shrink, never grow. On 2026-10-07 Anthony overruled the rule for the profile's two client tabs, CommunicationTab and IntegrationsTab, in `anatomy` and `controls`: "the profile is for clients" — a handful of rows each, under the profile's own small section headings, with no page footer, as drawn and approved (docs/plans/active/outbox-and-preferences-plan.md). On 2026-10-08 he approved the third, PreferencesTab (theme and language), in the same shape from the board ProfilePreferences, and it joins them. They are the only entries added after a list was made; the rule is unchanged for everything else.
